notes:
**The free report no longer prints the fix at the top of the page.**

The redacted report withholds the detail, the fix, the paste-ready markup and
the page list, and keeps the score, the ranking and every finding's title —
that is the trade, and it is the honest half to give away.

The summary at the head of the report is built from the findings separately
from the list below it, and it was not being redacted: each of its five lines
read "<the problem> — <the first sentence of the fix>". So the instruction the
report withholds twice over was the first thing on the page. It now reads
"<the problem> — Withheld in the free report."

A test now serialises the whole redacted report — every section, including ones
added later — and fails if any withheld sentence survives anywhere in it.

**A finding about a page that is not your homepage reads as English.**

"The page audited headline talks about you, not the customer" is now "The
audited page's headline …". It only ever appeared when you pointed Docket at a
section rather than a site root, which became a lot more common in 1.3.16.
